main_text.head: CLARISSIMO DOCTISSIMOQVE VIRO D. ANTONIO Fayo, Symmystæ & fratri charissimo.
main_text.p: NOn solus Solymæ rector vanissima cuncta Vbique dicit aspici: Hæc eadem dicunt aliy, qui Numinis almi Leges tremendas nesciunt. Non tamen est eadem, FAI, doctrina. Quid ergo? Hos mentis error impius Detestanda loqui, dirisque lacessere pellit Cælo tonantem vocibus.
Nam miserum esse hominem questi, quæ tanta malorum Circumvagantur agmina, Vel melius censent nunquam vixisse, vel aluo Mox matris egressum mori.
At si fata volunt mortalem viuere, raptim Oblata carpat gaudia.
Si contra quenquam infœlicia tempora turbant, Et longa vitæ tædia.

Nec tolerare queat patienti pectore tela, Trucémque fortunæ impetum, Reftes esse docent, caligantésque fenestras, Et alta rupium iuga, Flumina, mucrones, properantia pharmaca lethum, Ciborum & abstinentiam.
Queis quæsita modis mors ultima linea rerum Cunctos dolores finiat.
Sed quum Rex sapiens & sacra oracula vatum

page.notes: Woodcut ornament above heading not transcribed. Line-initial N is a large decorative initial, joined to "On". Some words in the scan are faint or spotted; "Reftes" and "Ciborum" read as printed. Words such as "FAI" printed in small capitals. The verse lines are indented alternately and are kept as one paragraph per stanza.
